text:
We're putting you in the center of everything we do ✨ #D23
Thomas Mazloum, Chairman of Disney Experiences, shared fan-favorite announcements at D23: The Ultimate Fan Event in 2026, including the reanimation of the Yeti at Expedition Everest, the return of Dreamfinder to EPCOT, and the transformation of Tomorrowland in Disneyland.
